shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json AGENTS.md 2>/dev/null; find .agents -type f | head -50

find src __agent_eval__ -type f | head; cat src/*.tsx src/*.ts index.html tsconfig.json vite.config.ts 2>/dev/null; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"'; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>&1 | head; .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button TextInput Select Switch Checkbox Text Flex Card Avatar ThemeProvider 2>&1 | head -80

bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button TextInput Select Switch Checkbox Text Flex Card Avatar FormRow 2>&1 | head -80; grep -n -i -E "Flex|Box|gap|spacing" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/layout.md | head -40

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && ls build/esm/components | tr '\n' ' '; echo; for c in Select Switch Checkbox Avatar TextInput Card; do echo "== $c"; ls build/esm/components/$c 2>/dev/null | grep d.ts; done

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && cat Switch/Switch.d.ts Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts Avatar/Avatar.d.ts; ls controls controls/TextInput; cat controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts; ls lab | tr '\n' ' '; ls ../hooks 2>/dev/null | tr '\n' ' '

cat Select/types.d.ts | head -150; cat layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts | head -60; cat Card/Card.d.ts | head -40; grep -n "validationState\|errorMessage\|errorPlacement" controls/types.d.ts controls/common.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm && sed -n 1,60p components/Avatar/types/main.d.ts; grep -n "ControlProps" -A 25 components/types.d.ts | head -50; cat hooks/useFileInput/*.d.ts; grep -n "Space\b" components/layout/types.d.ts | head -3
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && cat Avatar/types/common.d.ts Avatar/AvatarImage/*.d.ts Avatar/AvatarText/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -60; ls Avatar
npm run build 2>&1 | tail -15; git status --short
